stem: A crop has reached its expected flowering duration, but representative floral observations still show substantial developmental variation and plant condition remains acceptable. Which decision rule is strongest?
choices: Harvest because the calendar date overrides all other evidence
Delay indefinitely because calendars have no informational value
Use whichever single flower most closely matches the desired appearance
Treat the calendar as context and base the decision on repeated representative maturity observations, plant condition, and the defined harvest objective
rationale: Expected flowering duration can provide context, but it should not replace direct evidence. A defensible harvest decision integrates representative observations with plant condition and the intended outcome.
